tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Search verified, published Trust Onion Pulse (Voice Clone Scam Pulse) incidents by attack type, victim type, country, outcome, incident year, publication date range, and keyword. Returns compact summaries (newest first by default), a total count, and nextCursor for the next page. Call get_incident w

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Get the full published Trust Onion case study for one verified incident by slug, including source reporting and prevention analysis.

tools.name: get_scam_stats
tools.description: Return the current Trust Onion Pulse summary (all time, or for one incident year), including conservative loss classifications. Only explicitly-USD losses are summed.

tools.name: explain_scam_type
tools.description: Explain a documented editorial scam pattern with published article evidence, or a Trust Onion topic hub with warning signs and protection steps. Editorial coverage is not a verified incident count.

tools.name: list_scam_types
tools.description: List the current editorial scam patterns and published article links, separately from verified incident statistics.

tools.name: get_verification_protocol
tools.description: Return Trust Onion's five-step family verification protocol for suspicious calls, texts, and video calls.

tools.name: assess_call_scenario
tools.description: Deterministically match a described call or text to current scam hubs, red flags, and the recommended verification step. No external LLM is used.
